anchor: Which status makes me unable to move, lets attackers hit me with advantage, and auto-fails strength and dexterity rolls to resist?
What status leaves me with zero movement and turns every hit from a nearby foe into a devastating strike?
I want to bring back my dead friend in a new body, something that takes an hour and rare oils worth over 1,000 gold. Which spell does that?
If someone has been dead for ten days or less, what touch spell gives them a random new body from a species chart and keeps their memories?
Which touch spell lifts all hexes off a creature or object, yet a cursed item keeps its hex but is freed from its owner's bond?
Which touch spell takes one action to cast, needs only words and gestures, and ends every hex on a creature?
What spell lets me copy any other spell of level 8 or lower without meeting its requirements, just by speaking aloud?
Which 9th-level spell changes reality with only spoken words and takes one action to cast?
Which rare drink lets me pick up on what nearby creatures are thinking for ten minutes without needing concentration?
Which rare elixir has a pinkish mist suspended in violet liquid, and what does drinking it do?
Which fiend's polearm reaches 10 feet, slashes for damage, and leaves a bleeding wound costing 5 hit points at the start of each turn?
Which fiend's wound stops bleeding after a minute, or once someone restores hit points, unless the victim fails a toughness roll of 12?
Which character class uses charm as its main ability, rolls eight-sided dice for hit points, and gets proficiency with wisdom-based and charm-based saves?
Which character class starts with simple weapons, light armor, and either leather armor with a book of occult lore or 100 gold?
Which large air creature can't be seen, flies at 50 feet, and squeezes through a one-inch gap?
Which creature's whirlwind can seize a Large foe, and while held they can't cast spells that require speech?
Which 6th-level cleric spell calls a celestial, elemental, or fiend to help me, which then wants payment for its service?
Which spell lets me beseech a deity I know for a helper, and name a specific creature to request, though I might get a different one?
Which large beast with 40 feet of speed can knock a creature of Large size or smaller off its feet with a slashing swipe?
Which beast can slip away with a quick side move, either backing off without provoking or going out of sight, and sees in the dark 60 feet?
Which 2nd-level nature spell projects a silvery column of light, lasts a minute while I focus, and reverts shapeshifters to their true forms?
What spell creates a tall, narrow tube of light I can reposition 60 feet on later turns, dealing 2d10 harm on a failed save?
Which small elemental bursts with frost in a 5-foot radius when it dies, and takes extra harm from flames?
Which small flying creature breathes a 15-foot cone of freezing air every few rounds and conjures fog once per day?
Which chaotic evil fey creature can haul a grappled foe along without spending extra movement, and grabs from 10 feet away?
Which chaotic evil fey wears tough animal-skin armor, throws small hammers up to 60 feet, and has an escape DC of 12 on its grabs?
Which uncommon wearable lenses let me see without light out to 60 feet, and extend that range by 60 feet if I already can?
What uncommon worn item needs no attunement and gives vision in pitch-black rooms, meant to be put on over the face?
As a wizard, can I cast any spell with the slow-casting label without preparing it, as long as it's written in my spellbook?
If a wizard wants to cast a spell that isn't prepared, does it need the book in hand while casting?
Which large evil being regains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns and can shoot a ray that leaves me terrified?
Which large evil creature can change into a smaller humanoid or a giant form, and cast sleep, darkness, or gaseous spells once each per day?
Which legendary cloth, soft as silk and folded small, unfolds into a 6-foot circle that opens a two-way portal to another realm?
Once this magic cloth has opened a gateway, how long before it can open another, and who decides where it goes?
Which lawful evil monstrous shapeshifter bites humanoids, and an afflicted victim who drops to zero hit points rises as one of its kind?
Which monster makes two attacks with a crossbow or claws, and can't speak while in its animal form?
What 1st-level spell conjures up to ten gallons of drinkable liquid, or makes rain that puts out open flames in a 30-foot cube?
Which 1st-level spell dispels fog in a 30-foot cube, or empties up to ten gallons from an open jar, and uses sand as part of its material component?
When my cleric channels divine power, can I restore five times my level in hit points across wounded allies within 30 feet, with no creature topped above half?
What cleric move involves showing a sacred emblem as a magic action, spending a divine use to heal several injured people in range?
What tiny adamantine figurine grows into a 30-foot-high tower with arrow slits and a battlement?
Which tiny item makes a tower that can only be fixed by a 9th-level spell, and its door opens by a quick spoken command?
Which medium lawful evil fiend gets an edge on attacks when a pal stands within 5 feet of the target, and breathes a flame cone?
Which lawful evil fiend has a 50-foot speed and a bite dealing extra flame damage, yet is immune to flame itself?
Which small neutral evil elemental exhales a 15-foot cone that leaves foes unable to see until its next turn, and casts a sleep spell once per day?
Which small elemental bursts in a 5-foot radius when slain, dealing 2d4 blunt damage, and has a neutral evil nature?
Which 1st-level divination spell senses enchantments within 30 feet for up to 10 minutes, and is blocked by a foot of stone or a thin lead sheet?
Which low-level spell lets me see a faint glow around enchanted things I can see, and learn the school of any spell behind them?
Which 1st-level enchantment makes up to three foes in 30 feet subtract a d4 from their attack rolls and saves, using a drop of blood as a material?
Which spell lasts up to a minute and gets an extra target for each higher spell slot level, forcing a Charisma roll to resist?
Which challenge rating 21 undead spellcaster reforms after destruction if its soul container survives?
Which undead wizard's touch deals cold damage and leaves a target unable to move until its next turn, and it makes three attacks?
What uncommon face-worn crystal lenses sharpen my sight out to one foot, granting sight without light there and advantage on investigation checks?
Which common drink restores 2d4+2 hit points, and which rarer version restores 8d4+8 hit points?
What's the top-tier very rare drink that restores 10d4+20 hit points?
Which evil creature can turn itself unseen through a spell cast using Charisma and needs no components?
As a level 6 druid, how many spell levels can I regain after a short rest, and can I do that again after another short rest?
Once per long rest, can a level 6 druid cast a prepared spell of at least level 1 without spending a spell slot?
Which legendary wyrm can spend up to three uses between other creatures' turns to turn invisible, fire a thunderous burst, or lash its tail?
What's the rule for a legendary wyrm's extra moves: how many uses, and how many more inside its lair?
Which tiny undead floating light is very agile, can't carry gear, and makes itself unseen until its concentration ends?
Which undead lantern-like creature can finish off a nearby creature already at zero hit points to regain hit points?
Which medium crawling mass of tiny creatures squeezes through any opening a tiny bug fits, and resists being held or knocked prone?
What collection of tiny creatures bites with poison, deals less damage once it's down to half its health, and can't heal itself?
Which unaligned medium animal has 40 feet of speed, and after running 20 feet straight at a medium foe it adds 3 damage and knocks it down?
What beast gets an edge on its attacks once it has taken enough damage to fall below half its hit points?
As a paladin, can I use special properties on two kinds of armaments I'm trained with, and swap them after a long rest?
Could a 1st-level paladin switch from a long blade and javelin to a pole-axe and a flail after finishing a long rest?
As a sorcerer, how many points do I pay to create a 4th-level spell slot, and what character level do I need first?
What's the cheapest way for a sorcerer to create a 1st-level spell slot, and at what character level can I do it?
Which young medium chaotic evil reptile flies 60 feet, burrows, and has a 15-foot cone of freezing breath?
Which chaotic evil creature moves across ice without extra cost, and its swipes deal extra freezing harm?
While in my frenzy, am I immune to being charmed or scared, and does it clear those effects when I enter?
At what class level does a barbarian gain immunity to two mind-control-type effects while in frenzy?
What roll do I make to conceal myself, requiring heavy shadows or cover, and when does that concealment break?
If I'm sneaking out of an enemy's sight, what DC of a stealth roll is needed, and what breaks my concealment: a loud sound, or casting a spell with words?
Which 1st-level spell lasts up to an hour and adds 1d6 force harm to each hit against one foe I can see, plus an edge on tracking it?
If my chosen foe dies before the spell ends, can I shift that bonus to another visible creature within 90 feet by using a quick extra move?
